Commentary.Commentary: The hosts did their best, and maybe could have done better despite the lifeless track, had they held on to the catches. Lyon will be most disappointed as he had at least two dropped off his bowling. The rest did what they could, plugged the runs for as long as possible, till Rohit and Pant started to cut loose. Australia have about 25 minutes to bat, and India will look to milk every ounce of these minutes. A fun final phase awaits.

After almost two long days of batting, India have decided that what they have on the board is enough. Winning the toss and electing to bat, Agarwal and Vihari provided a solid start, with the former taking charge and scoring a fifty on debut. Kohli and Pujara then saw the first day out, continued in the second and eventually added 170 runs between them. The skipper scored a fine fifty, while Che went on to notch up a gritty ton. Towards the end, Rohit (who also scored a fifty) and Pant scored some quick runs and their partnership of 76 really provided the impetus India needed to peg Australia back.
Well, here comes the declaration. Those quick runs added seem to be enough for skipper Virat Kohli. He's seen coming by the boundary line and calling his boys in. INDIA HAVE DECLARED ON 443/7!

OUT! Hazlewood gets his man! This Test match is livening up now. An accurate short ball on middle and off, completely takes Jadeja by surprise as he can't do much other than hang his bat out. It goes off the glove and Tim Paine behind takes a regulation catch.
Fuller length ball just outside off, angling away, Jadeja gets low and looks to guide to third man with an open face, but gets beaten.
FOUR! Jadeja wastes no time to get going. Gets off the mark with a boundary. Full and right in his slot, he lofts this cleanly over mid off to find the fence.
Full delivery attacking the base of off stump, Rohit taps it down on the off side with soft hands and both batsmen cross over.
Length ball on the pads, worked away through mid-wicket for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja is the new man in.

OUT! GONE! The new ball brings about the breakthrough. Partnership of 76 comes to a close. Starc bowls a back of a length delivery and Pant swings hard, looking to clear the leg side. He instead, gets a big top edge which skies towards point. Khawaja there settles himself under the ball, watches it carefully and holds on this time. A bittersweet sight for Nathan Lyon for sure. It was clear the message was to score as fast as possible, so the southpaw's played his part.

FOUR! That ball went back as fast as it came to him. Overpitched around off, Rishabh Pant, with absolute disdain, dismisses it out of his sight as he smashes it straight back past the bowler for a boundary.
Angling away from outside off, on a length, Rohit looks to run it past gully. A half stop is made which allows the batsmen to take a single.

FOUR! He's taking the attack to Mitchell Starc. The Hitman going for it now. Full and wide outside off, Rohit Sharma drives this through the line and finds the gap between extra cover and mid off. The timing on it is so sweet that there's no stopping it.
Fires a fuller length delivery well outside off, Sharma uses the angle away from him as he drives it hard to covers. Can't beat the fielder there.
Josh makes it go away from outside off, Pant gets behind the line and defends.
Full ball outside the line of off stump, driven with the full face but straight to mid off.
Spills it on the pads, Sharma easily works it past the square leg fielder and three runs are taken.
Big swing and a miss! Length delivery outside off, Rohit looks to go big downtown. Only ends up connecting with thin air though.
Some extra bounce as Hazlewood lands it on a length around off, Rohit looks to cut it late down to third man but misses.
Length delivery angled across, outside off. Pant looks to cut as it keeps a touch low. Finds deep point and gets to the other end.
Josh Hazlewood to share the new ball with Starc.
Back of a length coming into the body, Pant looks to take the pull shot on. It goes off the glove and rolls down towards fine leg. One run collected. 9 have come from this over.
Goes for the yorker, ends up dishing out an overpitched delivery outside off. Pant drills it through the covers for two more.
A full outswinging delivery outside off, Pant leans into the shot and drives it through the covers. He runs the first one hard and manages to come back for the second.
Wide yorker outside off, fired well across, Rohit gets low, opens the bat face and squeezes it to third man for a run.
Yorker fired in on middle and off, Rohit does well to jam it out back down the track.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, Pant picks it off his pads and flicks it through square leg. Big gap out there, a triple results.
The third new ball has been taken by Australia and Mitchell Starc will bowl the first over with the new cherry.
Single down to long on to end the over and Pant keeps strike.
Another half-tracker from Finch and pushed away to long for another single.
Flighted and Pant lofts this towards long on for a single.
Flatter ball outside off, punched to long on for a single.
Flatter ball outside off, Rohit looks to defend but the ball goes towards square leg off the inner half of the bat.
Fuller ball outside off, driven down to long off for a single. 50-run stand is up between these two.
Rohit Sharma shows the full face of the bat as he defends from the back foot.
Picks it off his pads and turns it away with the spin into the leg side.
Stays right behind the line and blocks it out.
Rohit walks down the track and meets the ball at its pitch.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Spinning in on middle and leg, blocked.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Pant skips down the track and blocks it.

Fifty for Rohit Sharma, his 10th in this format. Well-deserved too. He was surely feeling a lot of pressure, will definitely take some off from his shoulders. He walks down the track and knocks it to long off for a single.
Walks down the track to this short ball and punches it to long on for a run.
Goes on the back foot and flicks it straight to the man in front of square leg.
Half tracker around leg, Pant defends it down on the leg side.
Aaron Finch is brought into the attack.
Tad straight in line, it's worked off the pads for no run.
Flat and short around off, Pant backs away and places the punch to sweeper cover for a single.
Back to around the wicket, it's darted full and on the stumps, played back to the bowler.
Comes down the track and wrists this tossed up ball to long on for one run.
Over the wicket now, it's turning in from outside off, Sharma meets the ball with the full face.
Slower through the air from around the wicket, on middle, it's worked on the leg side from the back foot. A single is collected.
Length ball on middle, pushed away back down the ground.

FOUR! Half-tracker from Marsh and at his speed, Rohit will always pounce on this length. Sharma pulls this away in the air and no fielder out there in the deep. The ball runs away to the fence and Rohit moves onto 48. 400 comes up for the visitors.
Fuller length on off stump, Rohit drives this off the front foot to mid off.
Length ball at the hips, worked away but Rohit doesn't want the run as the ball is too close to the fielder.
Outside off and Pant pushes it away towards cover and gets to the other end.
Length ball outside off, Rohit drives this well off the back foot for a single wide of mid off.

Drinks break. A long period of play after Tea. Australia picked up the wicket of Rahane and could have had Rohit as well as Pant had they held on to the chances that came their way. Unfortunately that hasn't happened and India have moved on to 397, having added 51 runs in the session so far. What will be interesting is to see if India will want to have a go at the Aussie openers for a few overs before Stumps or will they continue batting and pile on as much as they can.
Flatter ball on off stump, defended watchfully towards cover.

Another misfield, this time by Travis Head at short leg. Flighted ball on middle, Rohit works this on the leg side. Head, at short leg doesn't react quickly enough and allows the ball to go through. Single taken.
Flatter delivery outside off, punched down to long off for a single.
The ball is quicker and fired at middle, Pant pushes it back to Lyon.
Flatter ball on off, pushed towards point.
Flighted on middle, pushed down the ground for a single to long on.
Yorker outside off, Pant digs it out in front of covers to end the over.
Good length delivery, shaping away from around off, Pant moves a step across and blocks it out.
Some room on offer outside off, Sharma pushes it square to point and gets to the other end.
Rohit closes the face of the bat and finds the fielder positioned in front of square leg.
Fraction straight in line, on a length again, turned away on the leg side once more.
Angling back in on middle and leg, worked down on the leg side with gentle hands.
Fuller and pushed down to long on for a single. Rohit moves into the 40s. Keeps strike for the next over.

DROPPED! Straight into the hands and out! Flighted outside off and Pant goes for the big one over long on. Doesn't connect properly and the ball goes straight to Cummins positioned there. He just can't hold on to the catch. Single taken. Lyon cannot believe his luck here. The Aussies are looking a pretty tired unit. Can't afford to be loose now. Single taken.
Flatter outside off, defended on the front foot.
Quick, fired in on middle and leg. Pant is not outfoxed by the speed and pushes it out.
Another ball that is well outside off, Pant comes ahead and defends the ball.
Flatter ball outside off, kept out easily.
Length ball on off, Pant tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls onto the off side and the batsmen take a quick single.

Beaten! The ball is on a short length outside off and Pant goes for the cut yet again without foot movement and is beaten on the outside. Unlucky as Marsh has beaten the outside edge on multiple occasions today without success.
Short of a length outside off, punched towards the covers.

FOUR! 'That's the way to play', yelps Michael Clarke on air. Short and on a length at Marsh's pace, easy pickings for Pant as he swivels and hoicks this over square leg for a boundary. Good batting this.
Outside off, Pant stands in his crease and pushes it to point.
A flashy cut and a miss from Pant! The length ball outside off and it straightens slightly after landing, the batsman tries to cut but misses the ball.
Shorter length and fired in at the pads, Pant works it away behind square on the leg side for a single and keeps strike.
Looped up outside off, Pant comes ahead and defends on the front foot to the fielder at cover.
Another quicker ball outside off stump, the ball is pushed towards cover again.
Flatter outside off, pushed to cover.
Fuller and outside off, Rohit comes down the track and pushes the ball to long on for a single. That's the hundred, for Lyon.
Flatter delivery outside off, Rohit comes ahead and pushes the ball to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, Pant pushes this to point and brings an end to the over. The second new ball will be available in 6 overs.
Left alone outside off this time.

Loud appeal! Certainly seemed like there was some noise there. The Aussies go up but the umpire doesn't budge. Length ball outside off, Pant tries to drive this one but there is daylight between bat and ball as the replays show. The fielders have a talk and decide not to review.
FOUR! Full and outside off and Pant goes for the lofted drive over cover this time. Gets the placement right and the ball has enough on it to just trickle over the rope in the end.
Length ball on off stump, Pant tries to whip it away on the leg side but mistimes the ball to mid-wicket.
Wide outside off on a length, Pant lets it go.
Looped up outside off, Rohit comes ahead and smothers the ball onto the pitch.
Another flighted one outside off, Sharma defends comfortably.
Flatter ball outside off, Rohit come ahead and dead-bats this ball.
Shorter length and Rishabh rocks back and pushes this towards long on, slightly in the air but well away from the fielder at short mid-wicket. Single taken.
Quicker one full outside off, Pant comes ahead and defends it to cover.
Flatter ball on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Short ball aimed at the head of Pant, the batsman takes it on and pulls it away to deep square leg for a single. Keeps the strike. 8 runs off the over.
Wide outside off and left alone by the left-hander.
Length ball outside off, Pant pushes this ball to mid off.
Bouncer aimed at the head, Rohit gets on his toes and pulls it away to deep fine leg for a single.
Another similar ball and this time Sharma taps it to the other side of gully and picks up a couple. 6 runs off the first two balls of this over.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Rohit dabs it down through slip and gully for a boundary. Indian move to 375 and Rohit moves to 35.
Short of a length and Pant stands within his crease as he punches it towards mid on but the fielder moves quickly to stop the ball and prevents the single. 2 runs off this over.
Another ball on a length and off stump, kept out by the wicket-keeper bat.
Quicker ball outside off, Pant keeps it out on the off side.
Arm ball outside off and Rohit pushes it towards cover-point for a run.
Short and wide outside off, cut away to sweeper cover by the southpaw for a single.
Flatter ball on off, Pant defends by bringing the bat down just in time.
Length ball on the pads, Pant gets a nudged single towards mid-wicket and retains strike.
Another short length ball on top of off stump, Rishabh defends from within the crease.
Short of a length outside off, Pant pushes the ball towards cover-point.
Yorker length outside off, taken on the full by Pant as he digs it out towards mid off.
Length ball outside off stump, Pant reaches out and defends.
Fuller length outside off to start, Rohit drives it in the gap on the off side towards cover and gets another three.
Josh Hazlewood into the attack now.
Another quicker ball outside off, Pant pushes this powerfully towards cover. No run though. Maiden over.
Shorter ball to which Pant plays a defensive push from within the crease.
Flighted delivery outside off, Pant comes ahead and defends it towards the off side.
Left alone outside the off stump once more.
Outside the off stump and left alone by Rishabh.
Flatter ball on off, Pant tries to cut but gets an under edge that bounces and goes to Paine.
Good ball to end the over! On a length and straightens after landing. Rohit adjusts and defends it towards point in the end.
Short and outside off, Pant is off the mark with a cut towards the deep point region and a single is taken.
Short of a length ball that rears up a lot more than expected. Pant manages to fend this away on the leg side after jumping on his toes.
Pant shoulders arms to this one once more.
First ball to Pant, well outside off and left alone.
Lovely looking shot from the Hitman to begin the 150th over. The ball on a length is pushed into the vacant cover region off the front foot. The batsmen pick up an easy three.
Rishabh Pant walks out to the middle next.

OUT! Keeps low yet again and that is as plumb as it gets! Lyon has his first of the match and his first LBW of the series. Flatter ball on off and turns in while not even rising off the ground. Rahane who is stuck in the crease to play off the back foot is helpless and can't get bat on ball. The ball raps him bang in front and it is a very easy decision for the umpire. Rahane doesn't even consider reviewing as he walks off. The 62-run stand between the two R's has been broken.
Short and Rahane pulls this ball but straight to the square leg fielder in the circle. No single available.
Outside off and Rohit plays it wide of the slip fielder for a single.
Outside off, kept out towards point by Sharma.

Oooh! Rohit is looking very uncomfortable against Lyon here. Comes down the wicket and tries to adjust while defending this flatter one outside off, takes a feather, goes onto the pad and lobs towards short leg but just short of him. Lucky for Rohit yet again.
Flighted one outside off, Rahane comes down the track and pushes it to long on for a single.
Good length delivery on the fifth stump line, Sharma pants his front foot forward and pushes it in front of covers.
Bit fullish and outside off, patted away to the covers for no run.
Works it away into the leg side for a single.
Short ball into the body, Rohit rides the bounce and pulls it through the vacant square leg area. It won't go all the way, but it's enough to fetch him three runs.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
FOUR! Shot. Width on offer and shorter outside off, Sharma gets on top of the bounce and punches it square through point for a boundary.

Almost got him! Lyon gets this ball to bounce off a good length and spin as well. Rahane who is trying to flick it gets a slight feather on it and the ball goes on the pad and lobs towards Travis Head at short leg who can't react quick enough to grab the ball. Maybe the after effects of being on the field for 5 sessions. Lyon has every right to feel disappointed here.

DROPPED! The 12th man, Siddle has put down a sitter here. The ball was looped up around off and Rohit who was looking nervous defending the ball went for a sweep but only managed to top edge it towards the leg side. Peter Siddle who moved to his right seemed to lose the ball and dropped an easy catch. The ball rolled down and the batsmen crossed ends. Lyon should have had his first one there.
Another tentative defense from Rohit to this one looped up around off.
Fuller outside off, Rohit comes ahead and defends.

Loud appeal there! The ball seems to be doing a little too much and might have missed leg stump. Ian Gould is unmoved. Looped up on off and Rohit who is trying to work it on the leg side misses and gets rapped on the pads. The Aussies decide not to go upstairs. Replays show the ball would have missed the stumps.
Beaten! The arm ball from Lyon foxes Rohit who is playing for the spin and he is beaten as he is late on the cut.
Length delivery on middle, defensively pushed to mid on.
Length ball on off stump, Jinx defends towards cover on the back foot.
Length delivery that Rahane has to keep low to defend. The ball had kept low once more.
Shorter length ball and Rohit defends from within the crease. The batsmen pick up a quick single as well. Brings up the 350 for India.
Fuller length outside off, Sharma is half ahead as he defends the ball.
Outside off and left alone by Rohit.
Comes down the wicket again to this flatter ball but defends it in the end. Maiden over.
Shorter length ball, Rahane has time to defend from within the crease.
Jinx is down the track and blocks the ball.
Another quicker one on middle, worked away on the leg side.
Flatter ball on middle, kept out on the leg side.
Full and Rahane uses his feet to drive it down the ground. Lyon moves quickly to his right and stops the single.
Nathan Lyon to bowl from the other end.
At the pads, Rahane drops it on the leg side and the batsmen scurry through for a quick single. 50-run stand up between these two with that run.
Short length ball that keeps a tad bit low, Rahane stays low and keeps it out.

Luck favors Rohit here! Three men out there and the ball has gone right between the two gullies. Length ball wide outside off, Rohit with absolutely no foot movement whatsoever just hangs his bat out at this one. The ball takes an edge and flies in the gap. Single taken down to third man.
Drifting onto the pads, Rahane flicks it beautifully but just for a single to deep square leg.
Length ball outside off, kept out watchfully towards cover.
Fuller length ball on off, Rahane is ahead and drives this to Starc at mid on.
We are back for the final session of the day. Rohit and Rahane take their positions as do the fielders. Rahane will face the first ball to be bowled by Pat Cummins.
... Second Day, Evening Session ...

Probably for the first time in this Test match, that a session has been shared by both teams, to a certain degree at least. Starc and Cummins dismissed the two set batsmen, Kohli and Pujara respectively, and gave their side some hope. But since then, Rohit and Rahane have taking things under their control and even accelerated somewhat, especially the latter. 69 runs were added in this session, out of which 47 have come between the current pair. Maybe the Australians could take advantage in the final session with the ball turning a bit now? Or will the Rahane-Rohit pair go on to pile on more misery on the hosts? We'll soon find out.
Stays right behind the line of this one and blocks it out. TEA ON DAY 2!
Flighted ball served on off, pushed to the cover area.
A lot of loop on this, Sharma meets the ball with the full face.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Keeps it full and straight, pushed away by coming forward.
Looped up on the stumps, blocked from the front foot.
Angling back in on middle and leg, Rahane adjusts inside the crease before blocking it down on the track beside him on the leg side.
Keeps a little low as it's on the pads, worked to square leg. Dot ball.
Well outside off, on a length once again, one more defensive shot offered.
Length ball outside off, Rahane comes half-forward and blocks off the middle of the bat.
FOUR LEG BYES! Poor line and he pays the price for it. Going down leg, Rahane looks to flick it fine, does so but off the pads. It races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
On a length and it shapes back in, Rahane places the flick through square leg and comes back for the second.
Some nice air on this as Lyon pitches it on a driving length around off, Rohit comes forward and defends it solidly.
Knocks this down the ground to long on and crosses over.
Quicker through the air and shorter in length, Ajinkya presents a defensive bat in response.
Flighted ball on off, Rahane gets close to the pitch and wrists it to wide mid on before the ball can turn.
Short and flat outside off, he goes back again and taps it down square on the off side.
Quicker and straighter, full outside off, Rahane comes ahead and defensively punches it towards point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fires this full and on the pads, flicked straight to square leg.
Tight line as Marsh keeps it on a length just outside off, Sharma pats it down square on the off side.
Some movement in the air as Marsh bowls it on middle, comes back in, defended right under the batsman's nose.
Too straight in line, flicked to the man at square leg for nothing.
Back of a length coming in on leg, Rahane works it off the hips behind square leg for a single.
Lyon nicely tosses it up around off, Rohit plants his front foot forward and meets it with the straight bat.
Rohit goes deep inside the crease, goes with the turn and works it to short leg.
Quite slow through the air, around off, kept out from within the crease.
Flights it up on off, Rohit is well forward in defense.
Comes down the track, takes it on the full and knocks it to long on for one run.
Looped up off break around off, pushed away to the covers.
Change of ends for Nathan Lyon.
With the keeper up to the stumps now, Marsh bowls it on leg. It goes off Rahane's pads who misses the flick. A leg bye is collected.
Doesn't give much room, pitches it on a length on off, it's kept out from within the crease.
Fuller length delivery very close to off, Rahane responds with a straight bat in defense.
A silly mid on is in place.
Bowls it down the leg side, the batsman has nothing to do with it.
Touch straight in line, on a length, Rohit moves inside the line before clipping it behind square leg for one.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Mitchell Marsh is called back on.
At 146 kph, Starc angles in a length ball close to off, Jinx positions himself well behind the line and defends it on the off side.
This full ball is pushed tamely towards the mid off fielder. No run taken.
Nicely done. Shortish and just outside off, Rahane with an angled bat steers it past the diving gully fielder. Two runs are taken.
Fullish in length on the off stick, driven back down but to the man at mid off.
Rising off the deck, well outside off. Rahane has room to work with so he throws his bat at it. Fails to make connection though.
Full and outside off, Rohit Sharma leans into the cover drive and places it nicely in the gap through point and cover. Comes back for three runs. The score is now 333.
Looped up on middle, a front foot defense to end the over.
Shorter in length, Rahane stands tall and defends with a straight bat.
Fuller in length outside off, Rahane prods ahead and dead-bats.
Flatter ball and Rahane defends from within the crease.
FOUR! Rocks back and handsomely cuts this away! Short and outside off, Rahane uses his back foot brilliantly to make room and put this away to the point fence. Gets into the 20s with this boundary.
Around the wicket, flatter in length, Rahane pushes it back to Lyon.

Shouts of a leg before, but turned down. Height seems to be the issue. Starc generates some extra pace and serves it on off, it beats the outside edge of Rohit's bat and catches him high on the thigh pad of the back leg. Good call from the umpire.
Shortish delivery pounded in, on off and angling back in. Rohit is on his toes as he defends it down right under his nose.
Spears it in full once more, on middle, Rohit plays it around his pads as he works it in front of square leg.
Starc comes from wide of the crease and angles in a fullish length ball, Sharma defends with the full face.
Angling in from around off, it's run down to gully from inside the crease.
Full in length from around the wicket, outside off, it's driven to the covers but straight to the fielder there.
Mitchell Starc returns to the attack.
Floats it up on off, spins a touch with some extra bounce, catches Rahane on the pads as he presses forward to defend.
Too straight in line, worked off the pads carefully.
Rohit taps this square on the off side and takes off. Harris from short cover rushes to his left and throws it to the keeper, but Rahane dives well before there's any danger.
Quite slow through the air as it's landed outside off, Rohit pushes it gently in front of covers.
Uses his feet to skip down and ease it to long on for one.
The off break around off, spins in, Rahane turns it away on the leg side for no run.
Slightly fullish in length, on off stump, Sharma is rock solid in defense.
Attacks the stumps, blocked with a straight blade in response.

FOUR! That's the first boundary for Rohit Sharma. Superbly played. Sees the ball landing short, so he rocks back and decides to take the pull shot on. Places it through mid-wicket and finds the fence.
Too straight in line, it's defensively pushed away on the leg side.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Length delivery targeting the top of off stump, Sharma stays behind the line and defends.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Goes with the spin and works it to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off stump, it's played back down the track to the bowler.
Slower through the air, spinning in from around off, another front foot block from the batsman.
Fuller and outside off, Rohit prods forward and blocks it out.
Quicker and straighter around off, Rohit is well forward in defense.
Bouncer! Rahane lets the ball fly through.
Length ball at the pads, nudged away in the gap towards mid-wicket for a single.

Beaten all ends up! Outside off on a length, Rohit covers his off stump and tries to defend but the ball straightens and beats his outside edge on its way through to the keeper. What was also noticeable is that the ball keeps low to Paine and goes on a bounce.
Short length ball on the pads, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Short of a length ball outside off, Rohit stands tall and dead-bats. Rahane was looking for a quick single but is sent back sensibly by his partner.
Length ball on middle and leg, Rahane gets inside the line of the ball and works it around the corner for a single.
Flatter ball on middle, Rahane whips it away to deep square leg for another run.
Shorter ball that keeps straight, Rahane waits on the back foot and cuts it very fine and late. He picks up an easy couple.
Charges down the wicket and defends this flatter ball.
Another forward defensive shot to this looped ball outside off.
Flighted ball outside off, Rahane comes ahead and defends this one. Close to the pad but Jinx does well to get outside the line of off stump.
Flatter ball on middle, Rohit rocks back and works it away to deep square leg for a run.

Drinks break. Australia's hour after a pretty long time in the game. They have managed to see the back of Pujara and Kohli. The Indians are still slightly ahead at 313/4, but the Aussies surely have got an opportunity to come back strongly if they pick up a couple more quickly. Nathan Lyon to resume after Drinks.

FOUR! Wonderfully played late cut! Almost off the off stump. Short of a length ball on top of off stump, Rahane rocks back and cuts it away very late and in the gap through point and gully for a boundary. Lovely shot to end the over.
Short of a length aimed at the head again, Rohit takes it on this time as he swivels and pulls it away behind square on the leg side. He is in control of the shot, getting off the mark with a single.
Fuller length outside off, Sharma comes ahead and defends it onto the ground on the off side.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the ball.
Defended on the front foot towards the mid off region.
Outside the off stump, well left by Rohit.
Dot ball to end an eventful over. Some excitement suddenly in the match. Length ball on leg stump is worked away on the leg side.
Short ball on middle and Rahane brings out the pull on this occasion towards deep mid-wicket for another two.
Fuller ball and this time it is driven with some good timing through the covers for a couple.

In the air but safe! This ball on a length has got stuck in the pitch again it looks like. It climbs a bit more as well and Rahane who was into his shot early gets the ball high on his bat. The ball lobs up but luckily for Ajinkya, it is short of the mid-wicket fielder.
Fuller length ball outside off, Jinx comes ahead and defends it towards cover.
Length ball to which Rahane comes a bit ahead and defends with soft hands.
Well outside off and Rohit shoulders arms to end the over.
Short again, Rahane brings out the pull for a single to deep square leg.
Shorter ball at the hips, worked on the leg side.

FOUR BYES! The ball has flown out of nowhere and beaten the keeper too. Effort ball on middle and Rahane sways out of the way. Paine jumps to catch but cannot hold on to the ball as it goes off his glove and to the fence. The 300 also comes up for the Indians with these extra runs.
This is more outside off and left alone easily.
Outside off and left alone by Rahane. Came in slightly after landing but it was well judged by Jinx.
Josh Hazlewood is back into the attack, replacing Mitchell Starc.
Slightly fuller and on middle, kept out with a straight bat.
Solid defense to a length ball first up by Rohit.
Rohit Sharma is in at number 6.

OUT! Bowled 'em! This has snuck through and Pujara can't believe that he has been bowled. But he will have to go. One brings two as they say. Cummins and the Aussies have struck against the run of play again. This ball on a back of a length has kept really low and Pujara who was on his toes, expecting the ball to rise a bit more, was undone by the bounce or the lack of it one should say. Maybe the knock to his finger made him go on his toes initially as a trigger movement. The ball knocked his off stump and he stood there for a moment in disbelief before dragging himself to the pavilion. The marathon lasting 319 balls has come to an end finally. Great innings by the Indian number 3, has put his team in a good position.
Length ball on the pads, Pujara looks gingerly as he plays this towards the leg side.

The physio is out there to inspect Pujara's fingers. The ball seemed to have gone off the glove and Che needs some kind of attention here. Hopefully it will not be a serious injury and he should be good to continue.
This ball rears up from a good length and Pujara does well to remove his bottom hand and ensure that the ball doesn't go in the air. Looks like the ball has pinged off his glove.
Length ball at the hips, worked away behind square on the leg side for a single.
Short ball and wide outside the off stump. Left alone by Pujara to end the over.
Short ball on middle and the batsman stands tall to defend from the crease.
Shorter and wide outside off, Che climbs on top and tries to cut it away but the ball goes to the point fielder.
Well outside off, left alone by Pujara.
Length ball on off stump, pushed back to the bowler.

Cut away beautifully by Rahane. Short and wide outside off, the Indian vice-captain is playing his shots and has placed this well through the covers. The batsmen have taken a triple by the time the ball comes back.
Full in length, just around off and moving away slightly, it's defended with the full face of the bat.
Coming in at first but then straightening up a shade, Pujara gets a safe leading edge back down the track.
Short ball angling in on middle and leg, Che ducks and avoids it.
On middle and leg, Rahane moves inside the line and works it behind square leg for a run.
Length ball, attacking the off stump this time, Rahane gets right behind the line and defends.
Good length delivery outside off, dabbed wide of point for a single.
Short of a length delivery on middle and leg, Rahane gets on top and defends it watchfully.
Ajinkya Rahane walks in at number 5, replacing his skipper.

OUT! The partnership of 170 has finally been broken. Kohli has guided this straight down the throat of third man. Short of a length again outside off, Kohli goes for the deliberate lift, wanting to get it over the fence at third man, but doesn't have the pace on this one. It only goes right to a perfectly positioned Aaron Finch out there and it's a breakthrough for the Aussies. In the last two overs, he was looking a little stiff and was going for more shots. Another reason could be wanting to get a move on and score runs at a faster clip. Whatever the reason may be, Kohli goes for a well played 82 and misses out on a century. Has he given the hosts an opening here?
FOUR! Kohli has had enough of the short ball barrage. He pulls this short ball on middle almost to long on, just wide. No fielder present there and the ball goes all the way to the fence.
Short length delivery on middle, nudged towards mid-wicket.
Urgency in the running here! Pujara drops this one on the off side and sets off for a quick single. Quick response from his skipper too.

Short ball on middle, Kohli who was struggling with his back decides to pull it standing tall in his crease. The ball is in the air but safe. Doesn't have legs on it to reach the fence but it is an easy three.
A play and a miss! Pujara tries to cut a length ball outside off, misses the ball and it goes to Paine behind.
Length ball defended with a straight bat back to Pat.
No carry there and it is difficult for Paine to collect it. The ball is on a length outside off, bounces awkwardly in front of the keeper as Kohli shoulders arms. A bye is taken.
Length ball just outside off, defended towards cover.
Between the last over and the beginning of this one, Virat Kohli was seen with the physio. Maybe a stiff/sore back which he felt during that pull shot. Seems okay though, looks fine to continue.
Well outside off, VK isn't drawn into the shot.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Kohli.
Single to end the over. Short ball pulled away by the Indian skipper to deep square leg as he retains strike.
Length ball outside off, Kohli pushes it back defensively to the bowler.
Almost a similar ball and a similar reaction from VK.
Bouncer! Another duck from Virat.
Inside edge! Short length ball and Kohli looks to pull this one. Seems like he is into his shot too early and he gets an inside edge onto the pads. Or maybe the ball held up a bit on the pitch.
Good bouncer! Well-aimed but Kohli does well to duck and leave it.
Length ball just outside off, Pujara defends towards point.
Bouncer aimed at the head, CP ducks under it.

Overpitched and too straight, Kohli flicks it beautifully into the vacant mid-wicket area. Three runs taken, Kohli wanted the fourth but Pujara was not ready for it. The field is predominantly off side for the Indian skipper and thus, Cummins can't afford to stray onto the pads.
Length ball on top of off, Virat just defends this onto the pitch.
Good length ball outside off, comes in slightly after landing. VK lets it go after gauging the line and length.
Length ball on off stump, Kohli comes ahead and defends it towards cover.
Down the leg side and almost halfway down the track, Pujara tries to play the ball but misses.
Another effort ball just outside off, Kohli controls this one beautifully as he taps it down wide of point for a single.

The ball lobs up in the air but lands in no man's land. Bouncer to Pujara, climbs up a lot on him and he isn't in control as he tries to fend it off. The ball hits the glove and lobs onto the leg side in the vacant area. Single taken.
Very short and some width outside off, Kohli gets on top of the bounce and cuts it towards covers and gets off strike.
Short of a length ball on top of middle, VK defends back to the bowler.
Short ball down the leg side, Kohli goes for the hook but misses his shot. Looks like a set plan.
Mitchell Starc to bowl from the other end.
A length ball to end the first over after Lunch. Pujara plays it towards mid on. Maiden over.
Full and outside off, Che comes ahead and defends to the cover fielder.
Another short of a length delivery at the hips, worked to backward square leg in the circle.
At the hips, turned around towards square leg.
Length ball on top of off again, straight bat presented once more.
Short of a length ball on top of off stump, Pujara pats it back calmly to the bowler.

We are back for the 2nd session on Day 2. Cheteshwar Pujara, Virat Kohli and the fielders make their way to the middle along with the umpires. Pujara will take strike, bowling to him will be Pat Cummins.
... Second Day, Afternoon Session ...

One more session in India's pocket. The runs might have not come in bulk, a mere 62, but the visitors did not lose a single wicket. Pujara scored his ton, while Kohli has cautiously been going about his business as well. There were a couple of nervy moments, especially for the Indian skipper, but luck seems to be with him today. Australia needed early wickets but they failed to get any. The surface today is the best one for batting, and the second session is only going to get better under the baking sun. The hosts might be in for a long day on the field. Join us on the other side of the break for all the action.
Back of a length outside off, Pujara opens the face of the bat and runs it past the man at gully for a single. LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Pujara keeps his eyes on the ball, watches it land well outside off and doesn't bother himself with it.
Seaming away from a good length, left alone.
Wide! Way outside off, it goes across the other side of the tramline, so the umpire signals a wide.

In the air and it's just wide! Too far outside off and it's moving away, Kohli reaches out for it and gets it off the outer half towards point. Finch, with his helmet on for some reason, dives low to his right but can't reach the ball. The batsmen take a single.
Well wide outside off, an easy leave for the batsman.
Short of a good length around off, moving away from the batsman off the seam, Kohli stands tall and punches it to short extra cover.
No ball! The first one of this Test match. Marsh oversteps as he lands it on a length outside off, Kohli defends it on the off side.
Cheteshwar Pujara has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Bit quicker through the air, on middle and leg, defended off the inner portion towards the square leg area.
The batsman is out of the crease and blocks the ball before it can turn.
Floats it across, around off and fuller in length, Che blocks with a straight blade in response.
The 150-run partnership is up between these two. Around leg, Pujara helps it fine down the leg side and comes back for the second.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, defended stoutly towards short mid-wicket.
Needs to bring it in a touch closer. Marsh once again serves it around off, Kohli leaves it alone.
Fires it full, keeps it outside off, Virat drives but straight to the mid off fielder.
Full and straight from Mitchell Marsh, Kohli drives with the full face of the bat but finds mid on.
Too far outside off, some shape away and not much bounce on it. Kohli makes an easy leave.
Marginally ahead of a length and just outside off, it's kept out by coming half-forward.
Rising off the deck as it lands on a length wide outside off, Virat Kohli leaves it alone.
Stays back and keeps it out off the back foot.
Takes a step out of the crease and defends it with the full face.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Flat and on the stumps, worked to square leg but straight to the fielder.
Short and flat, pulled away on the leg side.

FOUR! Hundred for Cheteshwar Pujara, his 17th in this format. Take a bow, maestro. Another gritty knock. Has to be up there with one of his best knocks. He's played Lyon so well and continues to do so even now. Gives the charge and drills it through mid off to find the fence and get to the milestone.
A length ball once more, wider of off on this occasion, VK lets it through to the keeper.
Shaping away late from around off, on a good length, Kohli strides forward and blocks by reaching out.
Too straight in line, easy enough for Pujara to clip this down to fine leg. He rotates strike without any trouble.
Goes a bit square as Kohli places this through point and gets to the other end.
Drags his length back shortly, outside off again, left alone by the batsman.
Full delivery outside off, driven but straight to the man at cover.
Pujara comes out of his crease yet again and pushes it just wide of short mid-wicket.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Goes deep inside the crease and works it to the man at square leg.
Some drift away, around off, Che jumps out of his crease and blocks it in front of square leg.
Lyon continues from around the wicket and floats it up again, Pujara works it away, but straight to short mid-wicket.
Tossed right up there, on the stumps, it's driven to long on for a run.
Fraction straight in line, a length ball on middle, Pujara gets inside the line and turns it in front of square leg.
Comfortably done. This full delivery outside the line of off stump is driven through the covers for a couple of runs.
Length ball on off, Pujara slightly opens the face and pushes it to cover-point.
Stands firm once more, doesn't move much and defends it safely.
Touch short in length and on off stump, Pujara hangs back inside his crease and blocks it out.
Hits the good length area in the off stump channel, run down to gully for no run.
Mitchell Marsh to bowl for the first time today.
Looped up on middle and leg, Kohli presses forward and blocks it away on the leg side.
Around the wicket to Kohli, shorter and on the hips. It's nudged to short fine leg.
Good use of the feet again. Very good shot as he comes out and whips it through mid-wicket for three runs.
Just outside off, this time Che stands his ground and meets it with the full face.
Lyon pushes this quicker again, short and around off, Pujara is on the back foot once more as he keeps it out.
Quicker delivery on the stumps, Che goes on the back foot and defends it well.
Wide outside off and on a length, no shot offered.
Hazlewood serves it in the zone of apprehension, Kohli doesn't fiddle with it.
Bumper from the pacer, ducked and evaded.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Too far outside off, another leave from Virat.
Hazlewood hurls it in the channel outside off, Kohli watches the ball and then lets it go.
Wristed away with the spin, from within the crease this time, but straight to the fielder.
Pujara has given the charge to Lyon on all five deliveries so far. Works this one towards the bowler.
Steps out of the crease once again, it's blocked away comfortably.
FOUR! Lovely shot from Pujara. He gets his dancing shoes on and skips down, gets close to the pitch and hammers it through the covers to find the fence.
Once again makes use of the feet and defends.
Sees the flight on the ball and then charges out to push it away.

FOUR! As sweet as cotton candy. Beautiful shot from Virat Kohli, they don't get any better than this. Overpitched delivery on off, the Indian captain just presents the full face of the bat and times the drive through mid on perfectly for a boundary. Magic.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Wide outside off, another leave from the batsman.
Serves it on a length on the fifth stump line, Kohli does well to play with soft hands. Gets an edge which falls well short of Finch at that modified second slip position.
Too far outside off, Kohli leans across, covers the line and lets it go.
Rising off the surface after landing in the off stump channel, on a length, arms are shouldered.
Tossed up off break on middle and off, eased down to long on for a single.
Uses the depth of the crease to go back and works it to short mid-wicket.
Quick, flat and short outside off, the Indian captain goes back and offers a firm punch into the covers.
Straighter one outside off, driven through the gap in the covers and the batsmen take three. The 250 comes up for India.
Down the track again, this time it's wristed towards mid on.
Floated well outside off, Cheteshwar Pujara dances down the track and pushes it a bit square to cover-point.
Outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Slightly fullish in length and outside off, VK is half-forward as he keeps it out.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, it's left alone for the keeper to collect.
Just behind a length, on the fourth stump line, Kohli shifts his weight on the back foot and runs it down to gully.
Kohli is standing well out of his crease, so it becomes easier for him to deal with the movement. He comes forward and defends the length ball around off comfortably.
Full length delivery attacking the stumps, driven straight to the man at mid on.
Some flight on this one, around off, Pujara comes out to get to the pitch and blocks.
Goes with the spin and works it down in front of short mid-wicket.
Two close-in fielders now for Cheteshwar Pujara. Good thinking by Tim Paine, trying to put some pressure on the batsman now.
Pushes this towards the vacant mid on area and scampers across to complete the run. Nicely done.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Some decent flight on this, around off and coming in, Kohli taps it down on the off side with soft hands.
Spinning down the leg side, Virat attempts to flick but misses. Paine moves to his left, collects and whips the bails off. To no avail though.

Drinks have been summoned by the umpire. Another hour of play that India will be pleased with. Slow going but no wicket lost and the visitors will know it is all helping in building a launch pad for the batsmen to come in later. Australia need wickets, and quickly at that. Else, they could be staring at a long day on the field.
Shortens the length, Pujara immediately rocks back and defends the ball.
Length ball on top of off stump, chanceless defense from the batsman.
Short length ball outside off, Pujara stands tall and defensively punches this one to mid off.
Fuller good length ball on off stump, solid yet watchful defense from Che to this.
Defended off the back foot with a straight bat.
Short one outside off, Pujara looks to play the ramp shot but doesn't connect.
Flatter ball outside off, Kohli comes ahead and defends it.
Shorter in length and Pujara is let off the hook and he goes to the other end with a single towards cover-point courtesy a back foot push.
Another flighted ball to which Che comes down the ground and defends. The pressure is building.
Flatter ball on off and middle, defended to the mid-wicket fielder again.
Comes down the wicket again and pushes this ball towards mid-wicket.
Probing length from Lyon. Pujara has come ahead to this one and tries to turn it away onto the leg side but the ball turns just enough to beat the bat and lob off the pad onto the off side.
Four leaves in a row after the edge to end the over.
Left alone again as the ball is quite far outside off.
Another ball outside off to which Virat shoulders his arms.
The edge has immediate rearguard action as Kohli leaves this one outside off.

EDGED AND FOUR! The trap was set with an unconventional second slip who was wearing a helmet and a little more ahead than where a normal second slip would have been. Maybe that's what made him not dive for the catch. The ball goes just where a normal second slip would have been and the Australians can't believe their luck or Virat's. Length ball outside off to which Kohli comes ahead to drive but the ball takes a genuine outside edge and runs away wide to the right of Finch at that position. The chance may have just come and gone.
Good carry here! The ball is on a length outside off and Kohli lets it go.
Quicker ball outside off, Pujara comes ahead and dead-bats this. 1 run off the first Lyon over of the day.
On middle, CP runs down the track before defending this one.
Another flatter one on middle, Pujara has a bit more time on this one as he works it towards square leg this time.
Flatter delivery on off, Pujara turns the ball towards short mid-wicket.
Shorter in length, VK rocks back and pushes it to long on for a single.
Flighted delivery outside off, Kohli comes ahead and smothers the ball onto the ground.
Nathan Lyon replaces Pat Cummins.
Short length ball above off stump, Che gets on top of the bounce and defends the ball onto the ground.
Outside off stump on a length and the batsman leaves the ball through to the keeper.

A loud appeal but the ball seems to be going down leg! Length ball that lands on off and jags back in after landing. Pujara, who is looking to defend, misses the ball to get rapped on the thigh pad of his front foot. The ball seems to be doing too much and missing leg stump, hence the appeal dies down.
Well outside off and Che doesn't offer a shot this time.
Fuller length ball on the pads, Pujara flicks it but the ball finds the square leg fielder again.
Length ball on the pads, Pujara works it towards square leg.
Josh Hazlewood replaces Mitchell Starc.

Beaten once again! Must be the third or fourth time that Cummins has not got the edge of the batsman. Length ball just outside off, Kohli comes ahead to defend and the ball moves away very slightly to beat the outside edge.
Bouncer! Good bumper aimed at the head of the batsman, but Kohli ducks under and lets the ball go through.
Way outside off and not a ball that makes the batsman play.
Shorter in length outside off, VK gauges the line and length as he shoulders arms.
Good leave this time. There was a similar length delivery just outside off in the previous Cummins' over that Kohli was drawn into a drive but this time he restrains himself from going for the shot.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Kohli.
Bouncer! Pujara sways out of the line of the ball and wants to go for the ramp but decides against it in the end as he lets the ball fly through.
Length ball on off stump, Pujara defends it back with a straight bat from within the crease.
Good solid defense from Che to this ball on top of off.
Way outside off stump, left alone.

FOUR! Catch it was the call but the ball was well in control of the batsman. Full and outside off, Pujara comes ahead and drives the ball with an open face through the gap to the left of point. No third man and an easy boundary.
Another ball aimed at the ribs, good ball that. Equally well kept out by Pujara towards square leg, dropping his bottom hand at the last moment and keeping the ball down.
Short ball angling in on leg, Kohli initially wants to play at it but ducks at the last second.
Way outside off, no way Kohli chases after it.
Hits the deck hard and bangs it in shorter, Kohli gets behind the line and defends.

Beaten! That's the line Pat Cummins should be hitting more. Bowls it a tad fuller, just outside off and it nips away ever so slightly. Virat Kohli is drawn forward and he pushes away from his body, only to get beaten.
Similar length and quite close to off again, Pujara dabs it wide of point for a single.
Good length delivery around off, Pujara hangs his bat close to his body and defends it down on the off side.
Length ball aimed at the hips, CP tucks it away towards deep square leg for a single and retains strike.
Outside off on a length and Pujara defends it with soft hands and the ball falls onto the pitch.
Short length ball on middle and leg, straying onto the pads, the batsman fends this off on the leg side awkwardly. Maybe a bat-pad fielder should come in for this bouncer type delivery.
Outside off and away from the stumps, Pujara shoulders arms once more.
Well outside off and on a shorter length this time, but Che doesn't need to play because of the line of the ball.
Wide outside off and full, left alone by Pujara. The ball almost never rose off the ground there and went on a couple of bounces to Paine.

Full and angling down the leg stump, Kohli tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad. Slight appeal but it's only from the bowler. The replays confirm that the ball was clearly going down leg. The batsmen, meanwhile, run through for a couple of leg byes.
Wide outside off, left alone by VK.

Beautiful delivery! On a length just outside off and straightens a tad bit after landing. That beats Kohli who was looking to play it straight back down. Inches from the outside edge. Really good ball from Cummins!
Straying onto the pads, Pujara misses his flick and the ball runs behind square on the leg side for a leg bye after going off Che's pad.
Length ball again on off stump, Kohli comes ahead to defend but the ball takes the inside half and runs to deep backward square leg for a single.

Well left! Say this because it was Kohli and not Pujara on strike. The ball was on a length and not too far away from off stump and the Indian skipper prevented himself from going for the drive, something that comes naturally to him.
Quick! At 147.4 kph! But the ball is well outside off and the patient Indian number 3 lets the ball fly through to Paine.
Short of a length and the ball is closer to the sticks this time. Pujara stands tall and defends the ball back towards the bowler.
Left alone again outside the off stump.
Well outside off again on a length and Pujara, unlike Kohli, is not drawn into playing a shot.
This time he is much more ahead and leans into his drive through the covers. Just a mere push and the batsmen pick up three runs.
Beaten! Full ball outside off and Kohli is dragged into the drive but the ball holds its line and beats him on the outside.
Outside off and this is the second time today that the ball has gone on two bounces to the keeper. Length delivery that Pujara fails to connect his willow on.
Well down the leg side, Pujara tries to flick the ball but misses it.
Bouncer! Pujara ducks and evades the ball. It seems to have bounced a bit more today. From the same length on Day 1, the ball did not bounce so much and hit the batsmen.
Fuller length on middle and Che is slightly ahead as he defends with a straight bat.
This time the defense is out of the middle of the bat.
Length delivery outside off, Pujara hangs his bat out in defense. The ball comes off the thick inside edge and goes onto the pads.
Good shot on the off side but straight to the cover fielder. 8 runs off the second over of the day.
Well outside off, left alone by Kohli.

Full again but this time a little off target, on the pads and easily flicked away through mid-wicket. The ball doesn't reach the fence but the batsmen come back for three runs by the time Marsh retrieves the ball.

FOUR! Streaky. Australia won't mind this. Very full and on target, with the ball swinging inward. Pujara tries to dig the ball out but it takes the outside edge and runs away to the fence through the gap between the slip cordon and gully. The 100-run stand also comes up between these two.
This ball is on a line outside off and slightly comes in, Pujara plays it towards point with soft hands.
Angling down the pads first up, flicked away to deep fine leg for a single.
Mitchell Starc to bowl from the other end.

Fifty for Virat Kohli! His 20th in Tests. A full ball on middle that is flicked away to deep mid-wicket and the batsmen have enough time to come back for three. Good innings so far and the Indians would love for it go on long. 4 runs off the first over.
Outside off stump and left alone on this occasion.
Right on the money to the Indian skipper first up, on off stump. Kohli comes ahead and defends it with a straight bat.
First run of the day down to fine leg. Fuller and angling down the pads, Pujara flicks it away for a single.
Fuller in length and just outside off, blocked out from the front foot.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Pujara leaves it alone. The ball actually died down a bit before it made its way to Tim Paine. Interesting...

We are all set to begin. Cheteshwar Pujara and Virat Kohli walk out under the shining sun, and the duo will attempt to put on a big score on the board. Pat Cummins is handed the ball first up. Early wickets is the need of the hour for the hosts. Three slips and a gully in place for Cummins. Let's get this show on the road. Here we go...

Pitch Report - Allan Border feels that the pitch has dried out well and become harder than yesterday. He says that the surface should start assisting the spinners, and especially Ravindra Jadeja would be happy to bowl later on in the game with some rough patches being formed outside the left-hander's off stump. Also adds that the weather is pretty sunny and will aid in becoming the pitch becoming better for batting. He signs off by saying that Day 2 should be the best day for batting and India will be looking to post a huge total.

The opening day saw Mayank Agarwal score a fifty on debut, while Cheteshwar Pujara and Virat Kohli took things further from there. The pitch isn't exactly providing much assistance, but the Australian pacers showed some signs of life towards the end of day's play on Day 1. Pat Cummins was their best bowler, but some concerns remain over Nathan Lyon who picked up a slight knock while on the field. He should most likely be fine for today, the Aussies will surely hope that, otherwise that puts a huge dent in their plans. We have an exciting day ahead of us, so let's see how it pans out.

Hello and welcome for Day 2 of the Boxing Day Test at the MCG. It's quite nicely poised as things stand. At the end of Day 1, you could argue India have their noses slightly ahead in this Test, but the fact that Australia didn't let them motor away with the runs will give them enough reason to believe they can very much come back in this contest. A couple of early wickets and things become interesting again.
... Second Day, Morning Session ...

So, 215/2, then! A terrific Day 2 beckons on Thursday. Will the Indian mainstays of Kohli and Pujara continue their stay and push India towards a mammoth first innings score? Or will the Aussies come hard at them in the morning and have a say of their own on an MCG wicket that looked pretty lifeless and with some variable bounce on Day 1? Join us to find out all. Stay tuned for the coverage of the action from Melbourne which will begin at 10.30 am local (2330 GMT, previous night). Cheers!

Pat Cummins looked the best out of all the bowlers used today and he has been rewarded with both the wickets that fell. The rest of the bowlers haven't looked like picking wickets but have done well to stop the runs. Surely the injury to Nathan Lyon has affected them a bit and helped the visitors' cause a bit more. Mitchell Marsh was a good selection as bowling with just 4 bowlers on this wicket would have been really exhausting and considering the small turnover time between this Test and the next, there could have been some niggles to the faster bowlers had they been overused.

What a wonderful day of Test cricket. Definitely, India will head into the pavilion as the happier side but Australia will not be too disheartened. They have bowled wonderfully and restricted the scoring rate to less than 2.5 rpo. The pitch has looked demon less so far and the batsmen who are willing to spend time at the crease, will surely find a way to score runs. All the Indian batsmen so far have played more than 60 balls. Mayank Agarwal on debut, made a pleasing 76, especially considering the failures of the Indian openers so far in this series. Vihari looked solid in his stay but could make only 8 runs. The duo of Pujara and Kohli, which remains unbeaten at Stumps, has looked solid, more so the former who just hasn't given an inch.

Last ball of the day, huge cheer as Starc charges in to bowl it. Bowls a 147 kph ripper full outside off, almost too full. Kohli tries to put bat on ball but fails to do so. That brings an end to a great day of Test cricket. STUMPS ON DAY 1, INDIA ARE 215/2!
Length ball on middle, Kohli keeps it out watchfully.
Short of a length ball outside off, Kohli gets his bat out of the way at the last moment and lets the ball fly through.
Wider and full outside off, Virat pushes the ball to the cover fielder.
Another one outside off, closer to the stick this time but VK gauges the length well and lets the ball go.
Could be the last over of the day. Starc starts off with a ball on a length outside off and holding its line. Left alone by Kohli.
Well outside off, left alone comfortably for the keeper to collect.
Shortish ball which doesn't climb as much as it should, Pujara takes his eyes off the ball while trying to duck and cops a blow on the glove.
Serves it on a length again, outside off, tapped down on the off side with soft hands.
Good length delivery on the fourth stump line, Che gets an inside edge onto his pads as he looks to play at it.
Too straight in line, flicked away into the leg side for a double.
Cutting back in from a good length, on middle and leg and there's some extra bounce. Pujara is caught on the thigh pad as he fails to play at it. Height an issue, so no real appeal made.

Starc is spitting fire here suddenly and the ball is full and swinging in. Kohli does really well to drive this towards mid on. End of a terrific over from one of the best left-arm pacers in the world. Just showed his class after being on the field for more than 85 overs.
What a yorker! At 150.4 kph, Kohli does equally well to dig it out towards the leg side.

Loud appeal and the umpire says no yet again. Down the leg side by Starc, Kohli wants to flick it away but misses the ball. The ball comes off the strap of the back pad and Paine catches the ball before appealing. Good umpiring. Terrific bowling and a great contest late in the day.

What happened there? The ball on a length has taken off out of nowhere. Slightly fuller on a good length and coming in, the ball rares off and swings wildly after passing Kohli. Paine has no chance to catch this one and the ball runs away for four byes. What bowling this, at the fag end of the day.

DROPPED! Wide outside off after the ball comes in, Kohli goes chasing and gets an edge on this. This looks like it won't carry to Paine behind but it does just about. The keeper dives to his right and tries to take it but can't hold on. Very tough chance this but these are the ones if taken, that can change the course of matches.

A loud appeal but Ian Gould says no. Looks like height was an issue there. Brilliant bowling late on in the day from Starc, getting the ball to come in. The ball beats Kohli on the inside as he tries to drive the ball. Gets rapped on the inner thigh and there seems to be too much height so the Aussies drop their appeal.
A solid back foot defense to end the over.
Left alone by the batsman as the ball is well outside off.
Shorter length ball on middle, Pujara stands tall and defends.
Another ball closer to off stump this time, Che opens the face of the bat and pushes it to point.
Wide outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Great adjustment and control from the Indian number 3 batsman. Short outside off and Pujara hangs the bat from within the crease and places it beautifully for a boundary through the gap between slip and gully.
Fuller length on the middle, Kohli defends this ball into the ground.
On the pads, and goes off the pad fine on the leg side for a couple of leg byes. There is an appeal for LBW but the ball seemed to be missing leg.
Had him all beaten there! Wonderful ball from Starc as it comes in late and beats Kohli on the inside. Could have gone on to hit the stumps. Lucky, very lucky for the Indian skip there.
Another ball outside off, Virat lets the ball go through.
Short and wide outside off, left alone by Kohli.

Quick! At 144 clicks, but the line is outside leg and Pujara misses his flick and the ball goes for a bye as Paine can't collect the ball properly. Is it a set plan to get Pujara caught down leg like in the second Test?
A length ball and closer to the off stick. Kohli has to play at the ball and he keeps it out towards cover-point.
Another ball that has gone on two bounces to the keeper. Outside off and VK shoulders arms to it as the ball keeps pretty low.
Bowled from wide of the crease, lands the ball short and gets it to straighten. But Kohli lets it go seeing it is well outside off again.
There is swing but the ball is well wide outside off again, the batsman has no interest to play at these.
Another similar ball that shapes away outside off, Virat lets it go again.
Wide outside off on a length, Kohli wants nothing to do with it and lets it go through.
Josh Hazlewood to share the new cherry.
Excellent bouncer to end the over! It keeps rising after crossing the batsman and Paine jumps but can't collect it cleanly. The ball rolls behind for a bye.
Fuller and at the pads, Kohli flicks it away in the gap towards deep square leg and comes back for an easy two. 200 up for the visitors.
The batsman prods ahead and pushes this ball towards point.
Outside off once more, VK shoulders arms once more.
Well outside off, left alone by the batsman.

Beaten! On the money straightaway! Just outside off, draws Kohli onto the front foot to play at this one and gets it to hold its line. Beats Virat on the outside and the ball goes through to Paine. There is an appeal that ensues but the umpire is unmoved.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack and the new ball is taken immediately.
Shorter, quicker ball at the pads. Worked away to the deep square leg fielder for a single. India move onto 199 now.
Flatter ball from around the wicket to Kohli, he takes a stride ahead and dead-bats it.
This time the flick is in the gap and Pujara gets to the other end.
Quicker ball on middle, CP flicks it but the ball goes straight to square leg in the circle.
Flatter ball again on off stump, Che comes down the wicket and blocks the ball.
Outside off and flatter delivery, Pujara prods ahead and pads it away.
Good yorker by Marsh after the four, but Kohli is upto it and keeps it out towards cover.

FOUR! And every now and then, there is a show of brilliance from the number 1 batsman in the world. Full and on middle, effortlessly driven away wide of mid on for a boundary by Kohli. No stopping those.
Fuller length ball outside off, Kohli defends it into the ground with a big stride ahead.
Length ball outside off that holds its line. Kohli shoulders arms to it. The ball goes on two bounces to the keeper.
Another length ball outside off, defended from within the crease on this occasion.
Short of a length outside off, left alone by the Indian skipper.
Mitchell Marsh is on to bowl with the new ball due.
Finally finds the gap and a single is taken as the over comes to an end. Fuller on the pads, flicked away to square leg for a run. 1 run off the over. THE NEW BALL IS AVAILABLE NOW!
Fuller looped delivery on middle, pushed straight towards the mid on fielder.
Quicker one holding the angle, Kohli comes ahead and dead-bats it.
Another flick played off the flatter delivery on middle. But straight to the fielder.
Quicker ball on middle, VK drives this to mid on off the front foot.
Flatter ball on middle, Kohli plays it with soft hands towards square leg.
3 bouncers on the bounce! Pujara has let all 3 go. 1 over to go before the new ball will be available.
Another bumper on top of middle, Cheteshwar ducks under the delivery and lets it fly through.
Bouncer, going down the leg side and Pujara shoulders arms to this one.
Fuller length on the pads, CP flicks it away but to the square leg fielder in the circle.
Bouncer! Going down the leg side and Cheteshwar ducks out of the way and evades the ball.
FOUR! Wide outside off and cut away by Pujara through the gap to the left of point. The fielder has no chance to stop it.
Around the wicket and flatter drifting outside off, Virat is satisfied in defending the ball off the back foot.
Outside off stump and with a little loop, Kohli comes ahead and dead-bats it.
Another quicker ball on middle, whipped towards mid on.
Flatter ball outside off, defended coming ahead.
FOUR! Gorgeous! Very full outside off, Kohli drives this into the gap wide of mid off and the ball races away to the fence. These cover drives are an absolute treat to watch.
Flatter ball outside off, Kohli defends it with soft hands towards point.
Length ball on off and middle, defended with a straight bat.
Length ball on off, Pujara tries to defend the ball a little away from the body. It goes off the inside edge and onto the pads.
Ouch! Off the shoulder yet again today. Cummins bowls the bouncer at such a good length, the batsman is confused and tries to duck under it. The ball hits him on the shoulder and goes to the keeper.
Fuller on off stump, Che comes ahead and defends it into the ground.
A ball on middle and leg, Pujara stands tall and pushes it to mid-wicket.

Cummins has got to be appreciated a lot for his efforts today. Here again, he gets the ball to get some extra bounce by bending his back. Pujara though, isn't troubled as he pushes this one on middle to the square leg fielder.
Looped up generously outside off, Kohli absolutely smothers this one after taking a big stride ahead.
Another ball to which Che dances down the ground and flicks it away to deep square leg for one run.
Looped up on off or just outside, Pujara comes down the ground and pushes it to mid on.
Fuller and quicker at the pads, flicked away to deep square leg for a single.
Flighted ball outside off, VK comes ahead and dead-bats it.
Shorter and outside off, Kohli tries to find the gap through mid-wicket with a whip off the back foot but fails.
Length ball on middle, safely played away towards mid-wicket. 5 overs more before the new ball is available.
Bouncer! Pujara ducks and evades the ball going down leg.
Another ball on a good length, defended into the ground easily.
Similar delivery and even softer hands from Pujara this time.
Fuller on good length, played back to the bowler with soft hands.
Short of a length ball on top of middle, Kohli works it away on the leg side for a single.
Shorter delivery on middle, the batsman covers the line and defends easily.
Another faster one that holds its line outside off, Pujara hangs his bat out and drops the ball wide of slip. The batsmen pick up another two.
Quicker one on middle, pushed down the ground from within the crease.
Good looking shot for a couple from Pujara. Flighted ball on off, Che has his dancing shoes on as he comes down the wicket and whips it away to deep mid-wicket for two runs.
Flatter on middle and leg, VK flicks it away to deep square leg and gets to the other end.
Well outside off, Kohli shoulders arms.
Bouncer, going down leg. Left alone by the batsman.
Short length ball aimed at the ribs, Che defends gingerly. He seems a little worried about getting hit on his fingers again, looking at the way he played that one.
Overpitched and Pujara drives it beautifully down the ground wide of mid on for an easy couple.
The physio is out in the middle to have a look at Pujara's fingers. Hopefully it isn't anything serious and he should be okay to continue.
Ouch! This one has rared off a length and the ball has got his fingers. Must be hurting him as he moves away from his stumps and removes his gloves to have a look.
Fuller on off stump, Che comes ahead and defends it into the ground.
Bouncer! Pujara sways out of the way of the ball and lets it go.
Pat Cummins comes on to bowl, replacing Mitchell Marsh.

Drinks break in the final session. Has been another good hour and a bit for the visitors. A couple of close calls but otherwise they have looked comfortable. The run scoring hasn't been too fast from Pujara's end but Kohli seems to be on the move. Should be a really interesting final hour of play.
Fuller and flatter ball on off, pushed to mid on using the wrists by Virat.

NOT OUT! The impact is well outside off. The ball is landing outside off stump and the Indian skipper is well ahead to play this one. Gets beaten by the turn and gets hit on the pads. The Aussies go up for a review after the umpire shakes his head. Paine reviews it and the replays show us that the impact is well outside the line of off stump. Australia lose a review. Actually, a waste of a review. Looked pretty obvious to the naked eye as well. Seems like the decision was taken in a bit of desperation.
Kohli has been rapped on the pads, Lyon and the Aussies go up in a huge appeal. The umpire is unmoved but the hosts want to go upstairs for another look.
Shorter ball outside off, defended from within the crease.
Flatter ball on middle, pushed back to the bowler on the back foot by VK.
Flatter ball on the pads, again flicked to the fielder.
Shorter and quicker outside off, Kohli wrists it away but straight to the fielder at square leg.
Fuller and angling back in, pushed to the right of the bowler, where short mid-wicket comes and cuts it off.
Full and straight from Mitchell Marsh, it's played right back to the bowler.
Places this behind point with an angled bat and changes ends.
Outside off, the batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

21st Test fifty for Cheteshwar Pujara! A fine knock from the no.3 once more. Toughening it out there when his side needs him the most. He just dabs this behind point and takes a single. Brings up the 50-run stand as well.
Shaping into the batsman, worked away on the leg side.
No spin this time and Lyon lands it short outside off, Pujara rocks back in a jiffy and slaps the cut through covers. It won't go all the way, but it's enough to fetch him three runs.
Quite full and well outside off, Pujara comes close to the pitch and defends.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shorter once again, coming back in, kept out from the back foot.
Quicker through the air, flatter around off, pushed back to the bowler from the back foot.
Slower through the air, spinning in from outside off, Kohli lunges forward and leaves it alone.
On a length, on middle and off, Pujara positions himself well behind the line and blocks.
Full length delivery attacking the stumps, it's driven with a straight bat to mid on.
Hangs on the back foot and defends it rather solidly.
Waits for it to come, plays really late as he uses the pace and dabs it behind point for one.
Fullish in length and on off, defended by coming forward and with the full face of the bat.
Hurled too far outside off, no shot offered by the Indian captain.
Just behind a driving length, Pujara uses his feet to skip down and block it by getting close to the pitch.
Che goes with the spin and turns it away on the leg side.
Comes forward once more and blocks it out.
Spinning in from outside off, Pujara waits for it to come to him before defending it down with soft hands.
Virat eases this down the ground, towards long on and rotates strike.
Looped up on off stump, wristed down towards mid on. The batsmen take off and complete the quick run with ease.
Finally.... Nathan Lyon comes on to bowl. A little too late, maybe? He can still make all the difference, mind. Let's see how he goes.
Full and straight from Mitchell Marsh, it's wristed straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
Lands close to off and seams away late, VK gets close to the pitch with a big stride forward and pushes it to mid off.
Quite full and just outside off, drilled straight to the cover fielder.
Standing a long way out of the crease, it allows him to get close to the pitch and defend right under his eye-line.
Length ball just outside off, Virat walks a step down the track, goes a little across and taps it down in front of gully.
Nicely worked away. On the pads, Pujara glances it down to fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Edged and away! Starc is unlucky, unlike the batsman. It moves away late off the seam as Kohli reaches out for it. Plays away from his body and gets a thick edge which goes between first slip and gully. It runs away to the third man fence for a boundary.
Bouncer on leg, ducked and evaded by the batsman.

Unnecessary from Kohli. Starc is playing on his only weakness. He likes to feel the ball on his bat and the pacer is trying to exploit it. Full and wide outside off, Virat goes after it and mistimes it in front of point.
Back of a length delivery on off, shapes away late, Virat Kohli covers the line and lets it go.
Angling away, a good length delivery around off, kept out by getting behind the line.
Shaping away from around off, pushed to the covers for nothing.
Full length delivery attacking the stumps, kept out safely to end the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short ball into the body, it's pulled off the splice towards mid-wicket. Won't get any run for it.
Coming back in on middle and leg, worked away with gentle hands on the leg side.

No sign of Nathan Lyon yet. The fact that he's not coming on, against two batsmen who he's had good success against, can only indicate that he's injured. Earlier, on a fielding attempt, he jarred his knee and that seems to be the only logical explanation as to why he hasn't been brought on yet.
Nice and tight from Marsh, a length ball close to off, Pujara defends.
Short ball outside off, Kohli stands tall and punches it wide of point. Gets an easy run.
Mitchell Marsh comes back for another spell.
Down the leg side on this occasion, the batsman isn't interested.
Wide outside off, left alone.

Almost carries! Good comeback from Starc. Gets this bumper on target, Pujara who was trying to fend it away isn't fully in control and the ball is played in the air away on the leg side. It lands just short of square leg. Lucky for the batsman.

FOUR! Width offered and gleefully accepted by Pujara. The ball was short and well outside off, Cheteshwar chases after the ball and lifts it over point for a boundary. Easy pickings for someone who has played more than 130 balls.
Length delivery on the pads, worked away to the square leg fielder.
